title: iScala ERP Senior Analyst - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription: Job Description i Scala ERP Analyst At Johnson Controls, you will join a global organization focused on helping customers improve performance, safety, and efficiency across critical environments. In this role, you will support i Scala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. Role Overview The i Scala ERP Analyst will provide day-to-day application support across i Scala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 6-8 years of hands-on experience in ERP support or techno-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Provide functional support for i Scala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets. Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across i Scala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem. Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds. Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end-user training activities. Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment. Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies. Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution. Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance. How You Will Do It You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity. You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations. You will use structured problem-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues. You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone. You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time. Qualifications 6-8 years of experience in i Scala ERP support, techno-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role. Strong hands-on knowledge of i Scala ERP and related business processes. Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution. Working knowledge of MS SQL Server 2019, SQL Programming, SSRS Report Development, and SSIS Development. Experience with database management, complex SQL scripting, and investigation of ERP interfaces. Familiarity with Epicor Service Connect or similar integration tools is strongly valued. Ability to communicate clearly with users and cross-functional stakeholders in English. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team. Nice to Have Experience supporting i Scala localization, electronic invoicing, or compliance-related ERP functions. Prior exposure to hyper care support, system upgrades, Build/SIT/UAT cycles, or end-user training. Experience creating user documentation, support guides, or process notes for business users. Why Join Us You will be part of a collaborative environment where your work directly supports business users and operational stability. Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development. If you are ready to bring your i Scala ERP experience to a role where your problem-solving skills can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.

title: Project Engineer - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. What we offer: Competitive salary Paid vacation/holidays/sick time Comprehensive benefits package including 401K, pension, medical, dental, and vision care On the job/cross training opportunities Encouraging and collaborative team environment Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy Job Description – Project Engineer Employment Type: Contractual Role Summary The Project Engineer – CFS will be responsible for execution, coordination, and delivery of Fire & Life Safety (CFS) systems for Data Centre projects in the West region. The role involves site execution, vendor coordination, quality assurance, and ensuring timely completion as per project specifications. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Project Execution & Coordination Execute IBMS projects including access control, CCTV, fire alarm, PA system, HVAC integration, BMS/SCADA, smart sensors, and ELV systems. Coordinate with site teams, contractors, and OEM vendors for timely project progress. Ensure project activities comply with approved drawings, technical specifications, and safety standards.
2. Installation & Commissioning Supervise installation, testing, and commissioning of all IBMS/ELV equipment. Troubleshoot system issues and ensure proper integration of hardware and software. Prepare commissioning reports and ensure successful system handover.
3. Documentation & Reporting Maintain project documentation (BOQ, material tracking, as-built drawings, test reports). Prepare daily/weekly progress reports. Support project manager with project schedules and risk identification.
4. Client & Vendor Interaction Participate in client meetings and technical discussions. Coordinate with OEMs for material delivery, technical support, and warranty claims. Provide technical guidance to clients during installation and commissioning stages.
5. Quality & Compliance Ensure compliance with project quality assurance processes and safety norms. Qualification & Experience Diploma / BE / BTech in Mechanical / Electrical / Fire Engineering 4–8 years of experience preferred) Willingness to work on contractual payroll and project-based locations

jobDescription: Job Description Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away! What we offer: Competitive salary Paid vacation/holidays/sick time On the job/cross training opportunities Encouraging and collaborative team environment Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy What you will do The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction. Maintain project quality, on time delivery and manage escalations. How you will do it Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project. Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting. Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget. Creation of bill of material, selection of Backend, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System. Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc. Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction. Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences. Provides coaching and professional development to team members in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills to bridge the gap. Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects. Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team. Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress. Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives What we look for BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication). Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System Expertise in NFPA / BS 5839/EN/ FM. Proficient in Auto CAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, Power Point, Visio, etc.),Blue Beam. Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving. Proficient in written and verbal communication. Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills. Preferred 2 to 8 years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System. Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. title: HR Operations Specialist - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Who we are? Johnson Controls is the global leader for smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. At Johnson Controls, we’ve been making buildings smarter since 1885, and our capabilities, depth of innovation experience, and global reach have been growing ever since. Today, we offer the world’s largest portfolio of building products, technologies, software, and services; we put that portfolio to work to transform the environments where people live, work, learn and play This is where Johnson Controls comes in, helping drive the outcomes that matter most. Through a full range of systems and digital solutions, we make your buildings smarter. A smarter building is safer, more comfortable, more efficient, and, ultimately, more sustainable. Most important, smarter buildings let you focus more intensely on your unique mission. Better for your people. Better for your bottom line. Better for the planet. We’re helping to create a healthy planet with solutions that decrease energy use, reduce waste and make carbon neutrality a reality. Sustainability is a top priority for our company. We committed to invest 75 percent of new product development R&D in climate-related innovation to develop sustainable products and services. We take sustainability seriously. Achieving net zero carbon emissions before 2040 is just one of our commitments to making the world a better place. Please visit and follow Johnson Controls Linked In for recent exciting activities. Why JCI: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg Asia-Pacific Linked In: https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feed View=all Career: The Power Behind Your Mission Open Blue: This is How a Space Comes Alive How will you do it?  Provide specific assistance and processing WFA Processes, New Hires, Terminations, Employment Changes, Employment Verification, etc. including follow up with managers and HRBPs to clarify information, obtain approvals or request corrections.  Create new records, update, and maintain employee profiles and data in the respective HR systems of record.  Process the transactions accomplishing KPIs defined per processes and according to the Case Management Framework and the SOX Matrix.  Efficiently process purchase requisitions in compliance with procurement policies and guidelines by reviewing and validating requisition details, ensuring accuracy and completeness.  Generate purchase orders based on approved requisitions, considering specified requirements and supplier agreements. Ensure purchase orders based on approved requisitions are correctly submitted to the right supplier.  Contribute to the development, utilization and evaluation of internal processes to ensure efficient HR operations and customer service satisfaction.  Identifies opportunities for process improvement as it applies to HR practices and implements changes as appropriate.  Work within internal human resources information systems (HRIS; such as Service Now and Workday) to resolve broader issues or inquiries What we look for?  2
- 5 years of experience in a human resources role, preferably within an HR shared services environment.  Should have worked on Workday Software (hands on exp of minimum 2 to 3 years)  Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. Sound Knowledge of e Procurement systems such Oracle, Ariba will be an added advantage.  Flexible shifts to support EMEA. Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

jobDescription: Job Description About India Engineering Center India Engineering Center (IEC) is part of the global product development and engineering organization of Johnson Controls. Employing over 1400 engineers from multiple engineering discipline and specialization, we are spread across Pune, Mumbai and Gurgaon. We work in the product development space which ranges from core mechanical design, automation integration, development of embedded electronic components, software design and development, cloud application, machine learning and data science applications. About Security Access Control Business When Fortune 500 corporations, government customers, or any other enterprise applications concerned with critical security issues need a reliable solution in their day to day operations, more often than not, they turn to Johnson Controls and its security and event management technologies currently installed in thousands of facilities worldwide. Johnson Controls has built a solid reputation in the security industry as an innovator of security and event management technologies. With its continuous investment in R&D, and the ability to leverage new technologies, Johnson Controls has reached technological excellence. What you will do You will be a key contributor to the design, development and implementation of Mobile Applications for large scale, mission critical, access control and security systems applications. This position will focus on new development of mobile applications as well as maintenance and stewardship of existing mobile applications. This position requires the ability to work under minimal direction in collaboration with a team of engineers to design and develop robust system solutions that meet defined system requirements. We’re a collaborative bunch, so you’ll contribute to all phases of the SDLC, from planning, development, testing and release You will work closely with Scrum teams to deliver products on time with quality You’ll also coordinate with the Architect’s to understand and maintain an in-depth understanding of the current and upcoming requirements for proposed releases We work in a fast-moving agile set-up, so expect to pitch in with other responsibilities from time to time How you will do it You should be hands-on working closely with your peers in software development, testing, and Architects in the company to deliver best of breed solutions with your technical expertise. You will be responsible for below critical functions in helping us design leading products • Good understanding of GCP (Infra and PAAS) with around 5 years of experience in GCP. • Hands on experience with GCP CLI, bash, python would be an advantage • Good understanding and hands on experience of Tekton Devops and build pipelines • Good understanding of Docker, K8S and GKE • Good understanding load balancers, Ingress, ingress controller • Good understanding of Terraform, Helm templates and kustomize • Good understanding of Argocd, grafana, • Good understanding of SSL/Certs • Good understanding Postgres, Redpanda, Redis, Mongodb • Basic Networking Knowledge • Good understanding of Mimir, loki, tempo, graphite, keyclock What we look for Required BE/B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA Must have 5-7 years’ experience in Dev Ops Strong experience in GCP and GKE Working knowledge of Teckton, argocd ,kustomize, vault, helm, terraform Understanding of networking. Experience in working with Postgres, Redpanda, Redis, Mongodb. Understands Mimir, loki, tempo, graphite, keyclock Familiar with troubleshooting of Linux and Docker issue. Ability to work exceptionally effectively in a team environment is required. Self-motivation, tenacity, flexible and reliable in approach to work Preferred Knowledge of Grafana monitoring and logs ( loki) Familiar with Automated deployments of build Packs

title: Finance Manager - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Who we are? Johnson Controls is the global leader for smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. At Johnson Controls, we’ve been making buildings smarter since 1885, and our capabilities, depth of innovation experience, and global reach have been growing ever since. Today, we offer the world’s largest portfolio of building products, technologies, software, and services; we put that portfolio to work to transform the environments where people live, work, learn and play. This is where Johnson Controls comes in, helping drive the outcomes that matter most. Through a full range of systems and digital solutions, we make your buildings smarter. A smarter building is safer, more comfortable, more efficient, and, ultimately, more sustainable. Most important, smarter buildings let you focus more intensely on your unique mission. Better for your people. Better for your bottom line. Better for the planet. We’re helping to create a healthy planet with solutions that decrease energy use, reduce waste and make carbon neutrality a reality. Sustainability is a top priority for our company. We committed to invest 75 percent of new product development R&D in climate-related innovation to develop sustainable products and services. We take sustainability seriously. Achieving net zero carbon emissions before 2040 is just one of our commitments to making the world a better place. Please visit and follow Johnson Controls Linked In for recent exciting activities. Why JCI: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg Asia-Pacific Linked In: https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feed View=all Career: The Power Behind Your Mission Open Blue: This is How a Space Comes Alive What will you do? Provide monthly/quarterly reports and analysis of financial and performance KPI’s including P&L, Cash Flow and Trade Working Capital Develop, standardize, and automate business focused financial and performance reports using Business Intelligence tools Support month-end close activities and build working relationship with supporting Business Unit and Record to Report (RTR) teams. Analyze current and past trends in key performance indicators including all areas of revenue, cost of sales, expenses, etc. Preparation and presentation of Ops Review deck for business reviews with leadership. Provides timely and accurate data for financial planning / analysis and real time ad-hoc analysis. Compile financial information for business reviews. Assist with the preparation and loading of annual financial plans (including Opex and Capex plans), quarterly forecasts, monthly outlook, and pulse calls. Prepare financial records for the business; update and ensure alignment of mappings between ERP and One Stream. Operate within established finance procedures. Ensure adequate internal controls are maintained Prompt response to all information requests in a timely manner. Achieve deadlines set by leadership and the business and proactively support other peers to manage team workloads and support to deliver results. Provide real time ad-hoc analysis. Requirement and

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance; MBA/Master’s degree preferred with ACCA/CPA/CMA preferably Minimum 10-12 years of experience in Financial Planning and Analysis or equivalent experience in Accounting/Finance. Strong customer and business orientation and desire to develop business acumen, One Stream knowledge is a plus. Advanced Power BI, Microsoft Excel and Power Point skills. SQL/DAX knowledge highly desirable. Experience with SAP, JDE, i Scala, Baan or Oracle Business Suite highly preferrable. Highest standards of accuracy and precision; highly organized. Ability to think creatively, highly driven and self-motivated Demonstrated ability to roll-up sleeves and work with team members in a hands-on management capacity Strong communication and interpersonal skills and ability to work in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment Fluent in English (Written and Spoken). What we offer: We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

title: Position: Project Coordinator (Contractual)
jobDescription: Job Description Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. Position: Project Coordinator (Contractual) Location: Gurgaon, Delhi NCR Employment Type: Contractual Experience: 3-8 Years Industry: Electronic Security Systems / ELV / Building Automation Job Summary We are looking for a Project Coordinator with hands-on experience in Project Execution and Project Coordination of ELV and Security Systems projects. The ideal candidate should have experience managing site activities, coordinating with stakeholders, tracking project progress, and ensuring timely delivery of projects involving IBMS, CFS, CCTV, Access Control, Fire Alarm, and other ELV systems . Key Responsibilities Coordinate end-to-end execution of security and ELV projects across multiple sites. Monitor project schedules, milestones, and deliverables to ensure timely completion. Act as a liaison between clients, vendors, project managers, site teams, and subcontractors. Track procurement, material deliveries, and installation activities at project sites. Prepare project status reports, MOMs, progress trackers, and documentation. Coordinate site surveys, installation activities, testing, and commissioning. Ensure compliance with project specifications, safety standards, and client requirements. Manage project documentation including BOQs, drawings, work completion reports, and handover documents. Support project managers in resource planning and project execution activities. Follow up with clients and internal stakeholders to resolve project-related issues. Required Skills & Experience Experience in Project Coordination / Project Execution of ELV and Security Systems projects. Strong understanding of: IBMS (Integrated Building Management System) CCTV Surveillance Systems Access Control Systems Fire Alarm Systems CFS / Critical Facility Solutions Networking and ELV Infrastructure Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders and vendors. Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Project, and project reporting tools. Good communication and stakeholder management skills. Knowledge of project lifecycle, installation, testing, and commissioning activities. Educational Qualification Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Telecommunications, or related field. Preferred Candidate Profile Candidates from ELV, Building Automation, Security Systems, Smart Building, or Infrastructure project backgrounds. Experience working on commercial buildings, data centers, corporate offices, hospitals, airports, or industrial facilities. Immediate joiners or candidates with short notice periods preferred. Location Preference Gurgaon/Delhi NCR-based candidates preferred.

title: Oracle Fusion Americas - IT Project Manager - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Oracle Fusion Americas
- IT Project Manager Johnson Controls creates smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, and the teams behind our digital platforms help enable that mission across regions and business functions. In this role, you will support Oracle Fusion Americas initiatives that strengthen delivery, governance, and operational stability for the business. You will work closely with global stakeholders, delivery teams, and service partners to keep programs moving with clarity, accountability, and a strong focus on business outcomes. Role Overview We are looking for an IT Project Manager with 7+ years of experience to lead Oracle Fusion Americas projects and support activities. This role is suited to someone who can coordinate cross-functional delivery, manage priorities across multiple teams, and help ensure Oracle Fusion initiatives are executed effectively from planning through stabilization. Key Responsibilities Lead the planning, execution, and coordination of Oracle Fusion Americas IT projects, enhancements, and support initiatives. Manage project scope, schedules, dependencies, risks, issues, and action items across business and technical teams. Coordinate with business process owners, solution architects, functional consultants, technical teams, and vendor partners. Support governance routines, status reporting, and stakeholder communication for ongoing delivery efforts. Track production support needs, deployment activities, and incident resolution progress for assigned workstreams. Drive backlog prioritization and follow-up on approved enhancement and support requests. Support planning across onshore and offshore delivery teams to meet committed timelines. Help identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, reduce manual effort, and strengthen operational stability. How You Will Do It You will keep delivery plans clear, current, and visible to stakeholders, so priorities and timelines stay aligned. You will work closely with distributed teams and service partners, removing blockers early and escalating issues with good judgment. You will use disciplined governance, regular check-ins, and concise reporting to keep programs moving predictably. You will approach problems with a continuous-improvement mindset, looking for practical ways to improve process, quality, and response time. You will balance urgency with accountability, making sure commitments are tracked through completion and handoff is smooth. You will communicate clearly with both technical and business audiences, translating complexity into actionable next steps. Qualifications 7+ years of experience in IT project management, program coordination, or delivery leadership. Experience supporting Oracle Fusion ERP initiatives, enhancements, implementations, or production support. Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders across business and technology teams. Strong skills in project planning, prioritization, reporting, risk management, and issue resolution. Experience coordinating work in a distributed onshore/offshore delivery model. Ability to manage multiple workstreams, vendor relationships, and competing priorities effectively. Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. Nice to Have Experience with Oracle Fusion PTC, Project Financials, PPM, Project Contracts, Billing, or Revenue Management. Experience supporting Oracle EBS environments or broader ERP transformation programs. Familiarity with Major Incident Management processes and production deployment coordination. Exposure to KPI reporting, service operations, or continuous improvement initiatives.

title: Application Engineer III - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription: Job Description Job Description Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away! What we offer: Competitive salary Paid vacation/holidays/sick time On the job/cross training opportunities Encouraging and collaborative team environment Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy What you will do The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction. How you will do it Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project. Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System (Fire Alarm, VESDA , Linear Heat Detection, Fireman Intercom, Detection part of Gas Suppression System, Gas Detection etc) Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting. Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget. Creation of bill of material, selection of Fire Alarm Panels, Controllers, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System. Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc. Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction. Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences. Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects. Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team. Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress. Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives What we look for BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication). Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System (Fire Alarm, VESDA, Linear Heat Detection, Fireman Intercom, Detection part of Gas Suppression System, Gas Detection etc) Knowledge on Simplex & Zettler fire alarm product along with Xtralis, Securiton & Wagner product for Aspirating Smoke Detection system Simplex & VESDA certifications will have added advantage Expertise in Fire Alarm Code and Guidelines. Should be familiar with local code requirement for Singapore, Hong Kong & Malaysia region. Proficient in Auto CAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, Power Point, Visio, etc.), Blue Beam Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, Modbus, and other protocols. Should have good experience for subcon/vendor engagement keeping close co-ordination with procurement Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving. Proficient in written and verbal communication. Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills. Preferred 3-6 years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System’s Desing and Estimation. Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou . title: Proposal Manager-IR - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Who we are About Johnson Controls Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward. Visit johnsoncontrols.com for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms. What You Will Do Proposal Manager-IR will be responsible for delivering high‑quality technical support, solution design and estimation for Ammonia, Industrial Refrigeration systems. The role focuses on addressing customer inquiries, resolving technical challenges and preparing accurate presales documentation. The engineer will work closely with internal stakeholders and customers to ensure seamless support, proper solution alignment, and superior customer experience. Key Responsibilities Deliver, document, and support technical solutions related to Ammonia, Industrial Refrigeration systems. Troubleshoot and resolve diverse technical problems, escalating issues as needed to ensure timely resolution and Proposal submissions. Provide subject‑matter expertise during presales discussions, technical presentations, and solution evaluations. Manage customer complaints, technical queries, and support incidents professionally and efficiently for all presales activities. Prepare technical documentation, cost estimations and bill of quantities (BOQ) for proposed solutions and submit to respective stakeholders. Collaborate with sales, engineering, and project teams to ensure alignment of proposed solutions with customer requirements. Maintain strong awareness of industry trends, new products, and evolving technologies in Industrial Refrigeration. Ensure compliance with internal processes, standards, and quality requirements. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Refrigeration, Air conditioning, Mechanical, Thermal, Energy ) or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Design / Selection of Evaporators, Compressors, Economisers, Valves & Controls, Condensers / Evaporative Condensers and technical presales engineering. Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and customer‑interaction skills. Experience working with Industrial Refrigeration systems is must. Experience in HTRI / Heat Exchanger design preferred. Excellent communication and documentation skills. Skills & Competencies Technical expertise in Ammonia & Industrial Refrigeration systems, BOG
- Boiled of gases skid, Oil and Gas compression skid Proposals. Solution design & estimation Customer relationship management Technical documentation & presentation skills Troubleshooting & escalation management Collaborative mindset and stakeholder management

jobDescription:
Job Description Who we are About Johnson Controls Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward. What you will do : Design & Analysis: Perform mechanical calculations for pressure vessels, shell and tube exchangers, and columns used in Refrigeration industry & oil & gas applications. Code Compliance: Apply ASME Sec VIII, TEMA, and API standards to determine wall thickness, flange ratings, and nozzle loads. Engineering Deliverables: Create technical datasheets, material requisitions, and Review General Arrangement (GA) or fabrication drawings. Vendor Management: Prepare Requests for Quotation (RFQs), conduct Technical Bid Evaluations (TBEs), and review/Approve vendor drawings. Cross-Functional Support: Coordinate with Process, Piping, and QA/QC teams to resolve shop-floor or manufacturing queries. Qualifications & Requirements

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering Experience: Minimum 5 to 10 years in static equipment & Heat exchangers within EPC, OEM, Manufacturing, or consultancy firms.

SOFTWARE SKILLS:
Proficiency in design and analysis tools such as PV Elite , HTRI & Auto-CAD Code Knowledge: Deep understanding of ASME Section VIII (Div 1/2), Section II (Materials), and related codes (API 650, API 660 , TEMA etc.)

title: Senior Engineer – Chiller Performance Testing - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Qualification B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering Minimum 5–6 years of relevant experience in HVAC, refrigeration, chiller testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and performance validation Knowledge of: Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Chillers AHRI Standards NABL Accreditation Requirements BEE Star Label Program HVAC Controls and Instrumentation Test Bed Operations and Calibration Management Work Location Plot No. 2, Gat No. 180P, Global Industrial Park, Village Phulgaon , Taluka Haveli, Pune – 412216, Maharashtra, India Key Responsibilities – Sr. Testing Engineer / Assistant Manager – Testing The role primarily focuses on chiller performance testing, troubleshooting, test facility management, and AHRI/NABL/BEE compliance.
1. Chiller Performance Testing Conduct performance testing of Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Chillers as per production plans and priorities. Verify critical performance parameters, including: Cooling Capacity (TR or k W ) Power Consumption (k W) Input Power (k W) K W/TR or COP Analyze and validate test results. Ensure compliance with: AHRI 551/591 Standards AHRI 550/590 Standards IS 16590 Standards Prepare and maintain performance test records and reports.
2. Customer & Third-Party Testing Independently handle customer witness tests and third-party inspections. Coordinate testing activities with customers and inspection agencies. Prepare and maintain: Log Sheets Test Reports Minutes of Meeting (MOM) Ensure timely closure of observations and customer requirements.
3. Troubleshooting & Technical Support Diagnoses and resolve: Electrical issues Mechanical issues Refrigeration system issues Instrumentation-related issues Troubleshoot all types of chillers, including: Screw Chillers Scroll Chillers Centrifugal Chillers Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for failures. Support compressor overhaul, repair, and fault diagnosis activities. Provide technical guidance during testing and commissioning.
4. Test Bed & Equipment Maintenance Maintain and troubleshoot chiller test beds and support infrastructure. Conduct: Leak testing Refrigerant charging System repair activities Preventive maintenance Monitor: Refrigerant pressures Water temperatures System operating conditions Ensure reliable operation of test facilities and equipment.
5. HVAC & Controls Expertise Work on: HVAC systems Electrical systems DDC (Direct Digital Controls) Carry out: Installation activities System modifications Commissioning activities Ensure compliance with OEM specifications and safety requirements.
6. Calibration & Certification Management Monitor the calibration status of all testing instruments. Maintain calibration of records and reports. Coordinate calibration activities with approved laboratories. Ensure compliance with: AHRI certification requirements NABL accreditation requirements Verify measurement accuracy and instrument traceability.
7. AHRI/NABL Coordination Coordinate documentation required for: AHRI certification NABL accreditation Arrange: Witness performance tests Virtual performance tests Support AHRI/NABL audits and assessments. Coordinate with certification agencies and internal stakeholders. Ensure continuous compliance with the test facility.
8. BEE Star Label Coordination Coordinate documentation required for the BEE Star Labeling Program . Prepare and maintain: Technical documentation Performance reports Compliance records Liaise with consultants and certification agencies. Support: Product registration activities BEE audits & Assessment requirements Ensure compliance with current BEE regulations and guidelines.
9. New Product & Test Facility Development Participate in: New product validation Product performance testing Product launch activities Support the development of new testing methodologies. Supervise: Installation of test bed modifications Commissioning activities Infrastructure upgrades Recommend improvements to enhance testing capability and efficiency.
10. Safety & Compliance Conduct safety audits in coordination with EHS teams. Ensure compliance with: Company safety policies Environmental regulations Identify and mitigate safety risks in test areas. Complete all mandatory compliance training and certifications.
11. Continuous Learning & Software Skills Develop expertise in emerging chiller technologies and testing methodologies. Enhance skills in: Chiller Selection and Performance Analysis Software Lab VIEW Data Acquisition Software Test Automation Systems Support digitalization and automation initiatives within testing operations. Continuously improve technical knowledge related to HVAC and refrigeration systems. Overall, Role Summary Lead end-to-end performance testing of Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Chillers. Drive troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and technical problem-solving. Manage customer witness testing and third-party inspections. Ensure AHRI, NABL, and BEE compliance requirements are met. Maintain and improve test bed infrastructure, calibration systems, and certification readiness. Support new product development, certification activities, and testing innovation.

title: Senior Project Engineer - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. Role
- Project Engineer
- IBMS, Mumbai (1-Year Contract Role) Johnson Controls delivers innovative building technologies that support smarter, healthier, and more sustainable environments. In this role, you will support project execution and project management activities for IBMS delivery in Mumbai, with hands-on involvement in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS . This is a one-year contractual opportunity, renewable annually based on performance. It is well suited to candidates with a strong background in project execution or project management and practical experience in IBMS site delivery. Role Overview As a Project Engineer, you will help drive the execution of IBMS projects from planning through site delivery, coordination, testing, and handover. You will work closely with internal teams, contractors, vendors, and stakeholders to help ensure work is delivered safely, on time, and to the expected technical and quality standards. Key Responsibilities Support end-to-end execution of IBMS projects, including CCTV and ACS systems. Coordinate with project managers, site teams, contractors, vendors, and clients to support smooth project delivery. Monitor site progress against project plans, timelines, and execution requirements. Review technical drawings, specifications, and work instructions to support installation readiness and site execution. Track material availability, site requirements, and execution dependencies to help avoid delays. Support installation, testing, commissioning, and handover activities for IBMS systems. Raise and follow up on site issues, technical concerns, and coordination gaps in a timely manner. Prepare and maintain project documentation, progress updates, and handover records. Support quality checks and help ensure work is completed in line with project and safety expectations. How You Will Do It Stay close to the site execution work and understand what is needed to keep IBMS delivery moving forward. Own tasks and follow-ups with accountability, integrity, and a clear focus on delivering the right outcome. Use practical problem-solving and candid communication to remove obstacles and improve execution every day. Work as one team with project management, engineering, vendors, and site stakeholders, building trust through collaboration and shared standards. Keep documentation, progress tracking, and coordination updates accurate so that work remains visible and controllable. Qualifications Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field. Background in project execution or project management within IBMS projects. Hands-on experience in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS . Experience supporting site-based project delivery, installation, testing, commissioning, or handover activities. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and site documentation. Strong coordination, communication, and follow-up skills. Good problem-solving mindset with attention to quality and execution detail. Nice to Have Exposure to large-scale commercial, infrastructure, or facility-related projects. Experience coordinating with multiple contractors and vendors on active project sites. Additional exposure to integrated building systems or ELV project environments. Why Join Us This role gives you the opportunity to build strong IBMS project delivery experience with a global leader in smart and sustainable building solutions. You will gain hands-on exposure to project execution, strengthen your domain knowledge in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS, and contribute to meaningful work in a performance-based contractual role. If you are ready to bring your project execution or project management experience to a hands-on IBMS role in Mumbai, we encourage you to apply.

title: Quality Engineer - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Who we are : Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. Position: Quality Engineer – Project Company: Johnson Controls (or Johnson Controls–type projects) Location: Project Sites / Regional Reporting To: Project Quality Manager / Project Manager Job Description
- The Quality Engineer – Project is responsible for planning, implementing, and monitoring quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) activities across Johnson Controls project execution. The role ensures compliance with company standards, project speciﬁcations, international codes, and customer requirements throughout the project lifecycle—from design review to commissioning and handover. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Project Quality Planning  Develop and implement Project Quality Plans (PQP) in line with Johnson Controls Quality Management System.  Ensure quality requirements are integrated into project schedules, method statements, and execution plans.  Coordinate with project managers, engineers, and subcontractors to align quality objectives. Quality Assurance & Control  Conduct incoming material inspections, ensuring compliance with approved submittals and speciﬁcations.  Monitor installation, testing, and commissioning activities for HVAC, BMS, Fire Alarm, Security, or Energy Solutions systems.  Perform site inspections, audits, and surveillance to ensure workmanship quality.  Ensure compliance with applicable standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ASHRAE, NFPA, IEC, local authority requirements). Documentation & Reporting  Review and approve ITPs, method statements, and inspection checklists.  Maintain quality records including inspection reports, NCRs, CARs, MIRs, and test results.  Prepare quality dashboard reports and KPIs for project review meetings.  Support preparation of as-built documentation and handover dossiers. Non-Conformance & Corrective Actions  Identify, issue, and manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).  Conduct root cause analysis and ensure eective corrective and preventive actions.  Verify closure of quality issues and lessons learned implementation. Audits & Compliance  Support internal, customer, and third-party audits.  Ensure project compliance with Johnson Controls policies, HSE requirements, and client speciﬁcations.  Coordinate with certiﬁcation bodies and regulatory authorities when required. Stakeholder Coordination  Liaise with clients, consultants, authorities, and subcontractors on quality matters.  Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and ﬁnal inspections.  Provide quality awareness and guidance to project teams. Key Skills & Competencies  Strong knowledge of QA/QC processes in building systems or industrial projects  Familiarity with HVAC, BMS, Fire & Security systems (Johnson Controls product experience preferred)  Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and speciﬁcations  Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills  Effective communication and stakeholder management  Problem-solving and continuous improvement mindset Qualiﬁcations & Experience  Bachelor’s Degree/ Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, or related discipline)  3–8 years of experience as a Quality Engineer or QA/QC Engineer in project environments  Experience with ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems  Knowledge of relevant standards (ASHRAE, NFPA, IEC, ISO, local codes)  Professional certiﬁcations (CQE, IRCA Lead Auditor, PMI-related) are an advantage Tools & Systems  Quality management systems and audit tools  MS Oice (Excel, Word, Power Point)  Project documentation and reporting tools  ERP/Project systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent – preferred) Behavioral Expectations  Commitment to Zero Defect and Right-First-Time philosophy  Compliance with Safety, Ethics, and Integrity standards  Proactive approach to quality risk management  Collaboration across multi-disciplinary project teams

title: Safety Engineer - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Job Description Who we are? Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. What we offer: Competitive salary Paid vacation/holidays/sick time Comprehensive benefits package including 401K, pension, medical, dental, and vision care On the job/cross training opportunities Encouraging and collaborative team environment Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy Job Description : Safety Engineer What You Will Do
1. Bachelor’s degree/ Diploma in Electrical /Mechanical with Diploma in safety from recognized university /board(ADIS/MSBTE/NEBOSH).
2. Minimum 5+ years of experience in an EHS Role and experience in focused on lifting and hoisting equipment, with a strong background in environmental regulations, safety compliance and risk management.
3. Conduct regular risk assessments and job hazard analyses (JHAs) for lifting operations and other activities to identify potential hazards and recommend control measures.
4. Ability to prepare site EHS Plan, SWMS, Lifting plan and all other EHS related documents as per the customer requirements.
5. Strong knowledge in industrial projects with Crane & Lifting safety and ability to prepare & deliver the Lifting plan individually to customer.
6. Ensure that lifting operations are planned, executed, and monitored to minimize risks such as overloading, improper rigging, and unsafe working conditions
7. Lead the investigation of accidents, incidents, and near misses, identifying root causes and recommending corrective and preventive actions.
8. Prepare detailed incident reports and provide recommendations for improving safety practices to prevent future incidents

jobDescription:
Job Description Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. ROLE:
Compliance Executive
- Project Compliance (Contract, Mumbai) In this role, you will support project compliance activities in a fast-moving environment, working closely with project teams, customers, and subcontractors on a 5 to 6 month third-party contract in Mumbai. We are looking for immediate joiners who bring strong compliance discipline, project exposure, and confident Excel skills will be well suited to this opportunity. Role Overview This role is focused on project compliance execution, documentation, and follow-up. You will help maintain accurate records, support statutory and project-related compliance requirements, and ensure submission timelines are met across active project work. Key Responsibilities Prepare, review, and maintain project compliance documents, registers, and trackers. Support statutory compliance activities related to project execution and site documentation. Coordinate with the project team, subcontractors, and customer representatives to gather and validate required information. Track submitted documents, remarks, and pending actions, and follow up until closure. Support audit readiness by organizing records and assisting with on-site or document-based compliance checks. Assist with applicable registrations, licenses, and compliance submissions required for project work. Maintain accurate data in Excel and other MS Office tools for reporting and follow-up. Help resolve non-compliance issues by coordinating responses and ensuring timely updates. How You Will Do It Keep records accurate, complete, and easy to trace so every submission can be reviewed and closed without confusion. Stay close to the project team and site needs to understand compliance requirements early and prevent last-minute gaps. Use Excel as a working tool for control and follow-up, maintaining trackers, lists, and status updates with discipline. Own open items with accountability by following through on remarks, queries, and pending approvals until closure. Work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders so project, compliance, and subcontractor inputs stay aligned. Look for practical ways to improve the process by simplifying documentation flow, reducing rework, and making reporting clearer. Qualifications 3 to 7 years of experience in compliance, preferably in project-related environments. Experience supporting compliance documentation, registers, audits, or statutory follow-up. Good command of MS Excel and MS Office. Strong communication skills and the ability to coordinate with internal and external stakeholders. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet deadlines. Working knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards related to project compliance. Immediate availability for a 5 to 6 month contract in Mumbai. Bachelor’s degree in HR, Commerce, Business Administration, Social Work, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Nice to Have Exposure to IBMS industry project roles. Experience supporting BOCW, ISMW, or CLRA-related compliance activities. Familiarity with third-party or contractual project environments. Experience working with subcontractor compliance documentation and audit responses. Why Join Us This is a hands-on opportunity to contribute to project compliance in a structured, collaborative environment. You will work with teams that value clear follow-up, reliable documentation, and practical problem-solving while supporting important project outcomes in Mumbai.

jobDescription: Job Description Job Description What you will do The Sr. Quality Analyst supports the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple projects within a program. It is an excellent role for individuals looking to grow into a full program or project management career. Build and maintain program plans, timelines, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), and status reporting. Track milestones and follow-ups, coordinate stakeholders, leaders, SMEs and ensure actions are closed on time. Track program KPIs and present insights to stakeholders (quality, delivery, compliance, adoption). Build simple, reliable reporting mechanisms (Excel/Share Point lists/Power BI where available). Identify bottlenecks and propose data-backed improvements. Communicate changes effectively through release notes, announcements, FAQ updates, and training coordination. Support change management & Demonstrated performance as a change agent. Implement monitor and maintain QMS to standards, Regulatory & contractual requirements. Analyze data and provide information for management team to make decisions. Coordinate and conduct periodic internal audit, external audit, etc. Coordinate RCA process and be responsible for non-conforming database maintenance. Establish, maintain and improve metrics in Quality and Continuous Improvement. What we look for Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business or related field. Knowledge of ISO9000 quality system & ISO 9001:2015 certified PMP, Six Sigma Greenbelt Certification mandatory, Six Sigma Black belt Certification desirable. Strong documentation skills: ability to write clear SOPs, job aids, and communication updates. Comfort with data tracking and analysis. Strong stakeholder management: follow-ups, meeting facilitation, and structured communication. Good English communication skills. Skills Required Excellent communication, influencing and persuasion skills Teamwork. Self-motivated, good initiative and passion for continuous improvement. Good knowledge about how the organization works and knows how to get things done through both formal and informal channels. Strong functional and technical skills to manage and measure work commercially with an entrepreneurial flair. Demonstrate business knowledge and ability to display the linkage between projects and desired business results/KPIs. Possess an extremely high level of integrity and ethics when dealing with internal and external stakeholders. Ability to comprehend and make significant contributions to development of business plans.

jobDescription:
Job Description WD30274877
- Software Developer – Automat ion Position Summary We are seeking a Software Developer – Automat ion with strong expertise in Microsoft Power Platform, Generative AI, and enterprise automation. This role focuses on designing, developing, and implementing intelligent business solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, AI Builder, and Dataverse. The ideal candidate combines deep technical development skills with AI innovation, prompt engineering expertise, and the ability to mentor junior developers while delivering scalable enterprise solutions. Key Responsibilities Power Platform Development Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using Power Apps (Canvas and Model-Driven Apps) . Build scalable workflow automations using Power Automate Cloud Flows . Create and manage data solutions leveraging Microsoft Dataverse and Share Point. Develop reporting and visualization solutions using Power BI . Troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance existing Power Platform solutions. AI & Copilot Development Develop AI-enabled business solutions using Copilot Studio , AI Builder , and Microsoft Copilot capabilities. Design, test, and optimize advanced prompts for Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs). Build conversational AI agents and intelligent automation solutions. Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise workflows to improve operational efficiency and user experience. Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend innovative use cases. Integration & Enterprise Connectivity Develop integrations using REST APIs , Custom Connectors , and external enterprise systems. Connect Power Platform solutions with systems such as AWS services, Jira, Remedy, Share Point , and other business applications. Ensure secure, scalable, and maintainable integration architectures. Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) Implement and maintain ALM best practices using Azure Git and Git Hub . Support CI/CD deployment processes and version control strategies. Manage solution packaging, releases, and environment migrations. Ensure adherence to governance, security, and compliance standards. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Collaborate closely with business analysts, product owners, and stakeholders to define solution requirements. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior developers and citizen developers. Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to development best practices. Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to solution design decisions. Support production deployments, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400) preferred. 2 + years of experience developing solutions using Microsoft Power Platform. Strong hands-on experience with: Power Apps (Canvas & Model-Driven) Power Automate Cloud Flows Microsoft Dataverse Copilot Studio Power BI Expertise in Prompt Engineering , AI Builder, and Generative AI implementations. Experience developing and consuming REST APIs and Custom Connectors. Proficiency in SQL querying and data modeling. Experience with Azure Git, Git Hub, and ALM practices. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot and enterprise AI adoption initiatives. Working knowledge of Power Automate Desktop (RPA). Programming experience with Python, C++, and SQL . Experience implementing enterprise governance and security standards for Power Platform. Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and Dev Ops practices. Core Competencies Advanced Power Platform Development AI Solution Design & Prompt Engineering Enterprise Automation & Integration Technical Leadership & Mentoring Problem Solving & Critical Thinking Collaboration & Communication Continuous Learning & Innovation

title: Oracle Fusion Deployment Analyst - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription: Job Description Oracle Fusion Deployment Analyst At Johnson Controls, we help create smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. Our teams support the systems and processes that keep the business moving, and this role plays an important part in delivering reliable Oracle Fusion changes across the enterprise. You will work with a collaborative technology environment where accuracy, control, and clear communication help protect operational stability and support business outcomes. Role Overview The Oracle Fusion Deployment Analyst is responsible for supporting Oracle Fusion deployments, role configuration, user access management, and report migrations. This role partners with technical and functional stakeholders to help ensure releases are executed smoothly, validated thoroughly, and aligned with compliance expectations. Key Responsibilities Administer and manage Oracle Fusion role configuration, user provisioning, and access controls. Support application deployments, Fusion configuration updates, and report migrations. Coordinate manual deployment activities and assist with release preparation and validation. Work with cross-functional teams to resolve deployment issues and support implementation timelines. Maintain clear documentation for deployments, access changes, configuration updates, and handovers. Support SOX compliance and relevant compliance laws and regulations in day-to-day work. Use Git Hub and related version control practices to support controlled changes where applicable. How You Will Do It Own deployment activities with accuracy, accountability, and a strong commitment to compliance and integrity. Stay close to the work by working directly with stakeholders, clarifying dependencies, and removing blockers that can slow delivery. Use structured problem-solving and candid communication to improve the process with each release. Collaborate across teams, value different perspectives, and help deliver outcomes as one team. Validate changes carefully before handover and ensure updates are documented clearly for future reference. Use Git Hub consistently to support version control, traceability, and deployment coordination. Qualifications 5 to 9 years of experience in Oracle Fusion technical or deployment roles. Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion role configuration, user provisioning, and access control. Experience managing manual deployment processes in a controlled environment. Knowledge of application deployments, configuration changes, and report migrations. Familiarity with Git Hub and release-related version control practices. Awareness of SOX compliance and relevant compliance laws and regulations. Strong communication, coordination, and troubleshooting skills. Ability to work accurately in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail. Nice to Have Exposure to Oracle Cloud or adjacent enterprise application environments. Experience supporting automated deployment or release tooling. Familiarity with Oracle Fusion report types, integrations, or environment coordination. Experience working in audit-focused or controls-driven delivery processes.

jobDescription: Job Description Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away! What we offer: Competitive salary Paid vacation/holidays/sick time On the job/cross training opportunities Encouraging and collaborative team environment Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy What you will do The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction. Maintain project quality, on time delivery and manage escalations. How you will do it Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project. Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting. Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget. Creation of bill of material, selection of Backend, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System. Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc. Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction. Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences. Provides coaching and professional development to team members in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills to bridge the gap. Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects. Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team. Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress. Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives What we look for BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication). Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System Expertise in NFPA / BS 5839/EN/ FM. Proficient in Auto CAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, Power Point, Visio, etc.),Blue Beam. Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving. Proficient in written and verbal communication. Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills. Preferred 7 to 10 years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System. Stay updated on new technologies and industry developments in HVAC systems Join Johnson Controls and be part of a team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and provides a rewarding work environment. title: Engineering Manager: II
jobDescription: Job Description Engineering Manager: II Location: Pune What you will do Lead and manage a team of mechanical and design engineers focused on industrial refrigeration products. Oversee the end-to-end product development lifecycle from concept, design, prototyping, testing, to production release. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and marketing to ensure product feasibility and alignment with business goals. Ensure compliance with relevant codes, standards (e.g., ASHRAE, ISO, PED), and safety regulations. Drive continuous improvement in product performance, cost, and reliability. Manage engineering documentation, including BOMs, CAD models, and technical specifications. Evaluate and implement new technologies and materials to enhance product competitiveness. Mentor and develop engineering talent, fostering a high-performance team culture. Support customer-facing teams with technical expertise and customized solutions when needed. How you will do it Lead the mechanical design of industrial refrigeration products, transforming conceptual ideas into practical, manufacturable solutions. Apply core mechanical engineering principles to develop designs that meet customer specifications and project timelines. Create detailed 3D models and engineering drawings for refrigeration products, ensuring accuracy and adherence to customer requirements. Generate pressure vessel (PV) and heat exchanger (HX) drawings and specifications in compliance with order requirements, coordinating with PV engineers for timely submission. Prepare comprehensive manufacturing documentation, including fabrication drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), and other supporting documents. Ensure timely delivery of engineering documentation to meet internal and external project schedules. Guarantee product compliance with relevant industry standards and safety regulations. Collaborate with procurement and manufacturing teams to optimize designs for cost-effectiveness and manufacturability. Manage project schedules, identify risks, and ensure successful delivery of engineering milestones. Promote innovation and continuous improvement in product design and development processes. Provide technical mentorship and support to junior engineers within the team. Apply relevant regulatory codes such as China GB, ASME, and API in product design. Foster a culture of continuous improvement and cross-functional collaboration throughout the design and order fulfillment process. What we look for Required Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering . 14+ years of experience in industrial refrigeration product design, with at least 5 years in a leadership or managerial role. Strong knowledge of thermodynamics, heat transfer, and refrigeration cycles. Proficiency in CAD tools (e.g., Auto CAD, Creo) Experience with product development processes, DFMEA, DVP&R, and stage-gate methodologies. Excellent communication, project management, and team leadership skills. Familiarity with global compliance and certification standards (UL, CE, ASME, etc.). Preferred Experience with natural refrigerants (e.g., ammonia, CO₂). Exposure to lean product development and agile methodologies. Prior experience working with global teams and suppliers. Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou .
