jobDescription: Job Description What you will do The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for BMS Controls India projects as per vertical specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction. How you will do it Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project. Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Controls System (HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, PHE, Fire, Plant room system, and Third-party device integrations etc.) Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting. Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget. Creation of bill of material, selection of Controllers, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable & Cable Tray Type and Length Calculations related to Controls & CPM System. Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc. Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction. Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidence. Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects. Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team. Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress. Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives What we look for BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication). title: BMS Software Design - Datacenter - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Application Engineer (Software)
- Datacenter What you will do The primary responsibility of this role is to lead global Data Center Building Management System (BMS) engineering projects, ensuring compliance with project specifications, customer requirements, and account-specific standards. The role requires independent ownership and execution of projects throughout the entire lifecycle, while serving as the first point of escalation for technical and project-related issues. Ensure adherence to data center-specific engineering and project execution processes, maintain high quality standards through a "First Time Right" approach, and deliver projects on schedule to achieve operational excellence and maximize customer satisfaction. How you will do it Review project inputs like MEP drawings and engineering submittal to generate following deliverables for systems covered into Datacenter Project Configuration of software program for supervisory and DDC level controllers Perform simulation of software and validation reports to prepare for software commissioning package delivery Prepare FAT, FWT and SAT test script for validation of software Provide demo sessions to end customer for functionality check of software Optimize database with Trend, Alarm, Point COV management Coordinate with all stakeholders for clarification on RFI’s & progress tracking Perform FWT test at factory location Provide remote / onsite support for site commissioning activities Provide remote commissioning support to site team for troubleshooting issues, control loop tunning and guide site team with test script Perform 3rd party controller integration with different communication protocols like BACnet IP, Modbus and troubleshoot issues with help of software like wireshark, Mod Scan etc. Ensure quality assurance and defect free software package delivery Adherence with all processes and guidelines to execute project within timeline During pre-bid stage support sales team for providing/validating controls solution for systems into Datacenter project. What we look for BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical/ Electronics / Electronics & Communication Hands on experience with Software Engineering scope for Datacenter Vertical Good Understanding of Data Centre mechanical / electrical systems with expertise for instrumentation and control Able to handle complex programming for systems like chilled water system, CDU, CRAH, CRAC, AHU with redundancy requirement at equipment or DDC level Knowledge of HVAC systems from Datacenter vertical like Chilled Water System, Cooling Towers, Primary & Secondary pumping systems, Fluid Coolers, Heat Exchanger, CRAH, CRAC, CDU, Different types of AHUs, FCUs, VAV systems etc. Strong knowledge of BMS architecture with different types of Operator workstations, Supervisory Controllers, DDC controllers, Sensors & Actuators etc. Good understanding Network topology and architecture Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, LON, Modbus, OPC, and other protocols Able to handle Modbus, BACnet IP/MSTP integration Must be proficient in wiring of starters, field devices, safety interlocks & panels Experience in engineering, installing and commissioning of HVAC & BMS systems for Datacenter projects or other infrastructure projects like pharmaceuticals, airports, commercial buildings, hospitals Must be a quick learner & should have a keen eye for problem solving Proficient in written and verbal communication Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills Preferred 4 to 8 years of relevant experience in Building Automation Industry Datacenter Vertical, BMS Design Engineering or Industrial Automation. Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobDescription: Job Description Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward Job Description – Project Engineer (CFS Datacenter) – IBMS Background Location: Mumbai Department: Datacenter Projects / Critical Facilities Services (CFS) Position Summary We are seeking a skilled Project Engineer with experience in Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS/BMS) for Datacenter projects. The candidate will be responsible for planning, execution, commissioning, testing, and coordination of IBMS systems across critical datacenter environments while ensuring adherence to project timelines, quality standards, and client requirements. Key Responsibilities Execute and manage IBMS/BMS installation, testing, commissioning, and integration activities for datacenter projects. Coordinate with clients, consultants, OEMs, vendors, and internal stakeholders during project execution. Review technical drawings, BOQs, specifications, schematics, and control logic related to BMS/IBMS systems. Monitor project schedules, resource allocation, and site activities to ensure timely delivery. Supervise field engineers, subcontractors, and installation teams. Perform FAT, SAT, loop checks, point-to-point testing, and system validation. Ensure seamless integration of HVAC, Electrical, Fire Alarm, Access Control, CCTV, EPMS, and other critical building systems with IBMS. Prepare project documentation, progress reports, commissioning reports, and handover documents. Troubleshoot system issues and provide technical support during commissioning and post-deployment phases. Adhere to safety standards, quality procedures, and datacenter compliance requirements. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or related engineering discipline. 3–8 years of experience in BMS/IBMS projects, preferably in Datacenter, Commercial Buildings, Hospitals, Airports, or Critical Infrastructure projects. Hands-on experience with IBMS/BMS platforms such as Schneider Eco Struxure, Honeywell EBI, Siemens Desigo, Johnson Controls Metasys, Delta Controls, or equivalent. Understanding of HVAC controls, Chillers, AHUs, PAC systems, Electrical Monitoring Systems, Fire & Security integrations. Knowledge of communication protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, OPC, TCP/IP, and SNMP. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and control schematics. Desired Skills Datacenter project experience will be preferred. Strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills. Good troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent communication and client-facing skills. Willingness to travel across project sites as required. Preferred Certifications BMS/IBMS OEM Certifications. PMP/Prince2 (added advantage). Datacenter or Critical Facilities certifications (preferred). Compensation Best in the industry, depending on experience and expertise.

jobDescription: Job Description Job Summary We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Workday Payroll & Benefits Configuration Analyst with 1+ years of experience in Workday Payroll and Benefits administration. The ideal candidate will support the configuration, maintenance, testing, and optimization of Workday Payroll and Benefits processes while ensuring data accuracy, compliance, and excellent employee experience. Key Responsibilities Assist in the configuration and maintenance of Workday Payroll processes and payroll-related business processes. Troubleshoot payroll issues and partner with Payroll teams to resolve on BAU issues. Perform system audits and data validation activities to ensure accuracy and compliance. Support payroll-related reporting and analytics using Workday reports. Configure and maintain Workday Benefit plans, eligibility rules, enrollments, life events, and benefit elections. Monitor and work with HR-IT to troubleshoot benefits integrations issues. Collaborate with Benefits vendors, HR Operations, and Payroll teams. Workday Support & Testing Participate in Workday bi-annual release testing and implementation of new features. Analyze business requirements and assist in system enhancements. Document configurations, test scripts, and process workflows. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, or related field. 1–2 years of experience supporting Workday Payroll and/or Benefits modules. Basic understanding of payroll processing, deductions, taxes, and benefits administration. Experience with Workday reporting and data analysis. Knowledge of employee life cycle events and HR business processes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Workday Payroll, Benefits, and HCM modules. Exposure to Workday Business Process, EIBs, integrations, and security roles. Experience supporting payroll audits and compliance requirements. Workday certification or Workday implementation/support experience is an added advantage. Technical Skills Workday Payroll Workday Benefits Workday HCM Business Process Configuration Workday Reporting Calculated Fields EIB (Enterprise Interface Builder) Key Competencies Attention to Detail Problem Solving Analytical Thinking Stakeholder Management Team Collaboration

title: POD Leader- Fire Suppression - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away! What we offer: Competitive salary Paid vacation/holidays/sick time On the job/cross training opportunities Encouraging and collaborative team environment Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy What you do The primary responsibility for this role is to lead Fire Protection and Suppression POD efficiently, achieving required KPIs’ and delivering jobs per Stakeholders’ requirements. How will you do it
1. Demonstrate strong domain expertise in Fire Protection and Suppression systems.
2. Bring 10–12 years of global, customer-facing experience in fire protection projects.
3. Own and drive Squad KPIs, including performance tracking and implementation of corrective countermeasures.
4. Ensure compliance with regional/area-specific standards and norms.
5. Manage case distribution across the squad to balance workload effectively.
6. Proactively address and resolve people conflicts within the team.
7. Execute silo risk mitigation by managing peak and valley workloads, maintaining utilization between 90%–110%.
8. Take end-to-end responsibility for KPI’s, as defined by each region.
9. Ensure timesheet approval and accuracy.
10. Lead and conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for quality, delivery, or productivity issues.
11. Ensure QA/QC adherence, including proper documentation and logging.
12. Identify squad competency gaps and drive required training and upskilling initiatives.
13. Act as the primary interface with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring projects are executed within agreed schedules, budgets, and customer technical specifications.
14. Effectively manage and mentor a team of 10–12 designers.
15. Deliver weekly and monthly stakeholder reports covering project progress, risks, and mitigation plans.
16. Actively participate in and support organizational employee engagement initiatives.
1. BE / ME in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics & Communication Engineering.
2. 10–12 years of mandatory experience in Fire Protection Systems.
3. Proven experience in leading teams of 10–12 members.
4. Strong expertise in BSEN, FM, and NFPA standards.
5. Proficiency in Auto CAD and MS Office tools (Word, Excel, Power Point, Visio).
6. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
7. Ability to demonstrate strong leadership, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred 10 to 12 years of relevant experience in Fire Protection Domain. title: Application Engineer- Fire & Security - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription: Job Description Job Description What you will do This position is responsible to design Fire & security systems like Fire Alarm, Access Control, Intruder Alarm, and CCTV per respective account standards. How you will do it Should have strong domain knowledge of Fire & Security System engineering. Should have global customer facing experience. Works independently & is fully proficient in applying established standards/practices. Should act as interface to customers and is responsible to ensure that projects are executed within agreed schedule and budget to meet the customer technical specification requirements. Should be able to independently carry out Hardware Detail Design, Engineering and Application Development, Battery Calculations, Voltage drops calculations etc. Should be able to develop Typical / Templates for Complex systems and develop project specific standards. Should be able to read, Understand Control Narratives, Logic diagrams, Io Matrix etc. Monitors and controls assigned work scope against the project plan, ensures effective change control, and identifies risks / opportunities. Ensures that the proposed engineered solution meets project requirements in terms of functionality, standards, quality, and supporting documentation. Ensure group work in compliance with QMS procedures. Identify possible improvement opportunities and manage their implementation. Ensure common methods, techniques, tools, and products are being effectively applied and provide feedback for future improvement. Ensures that the implementation of application is reviewed with respect to project standards and quality documents. Ensures that the final deliverable meets the functional specifications of the customer by doing the quality checks. Usage of engineering tools for optimization of Engineering man hours to improve productivity & Quality. What we look for Diploma/BE (Electrical/ Electronics). 3-8 years’ experience in Fire & security system design is mandatory. Fire code & security domain knowledge mandatory. NICET/ BS 5839 & Security system product Certifications will be added advantage. Good knowledge of Auto CAD. Good communication skills.

title: Specialist, HR Operations - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Johnson Controls is seeking a highly motivated and experienced HR Operations Specialist. The HR Operations Specialist will play a critical role in supporting day-to-day HR operations and ensuring processing of transactions with high accuracy and attention to detail. Scope involves processing of Hiring, Reference Letters, Personal data changes, Job data changes, Terminations and more. The role will involve transition of processes from offshore locations and hence the incumbent will ensure the learning curve is maintained until self-sufficiency within transition timelines What you will do Primary jobs involve handling job requisitions such as bulk creation, validation and approval using various business rules. Processes other workday administration such New Hires, Terminations, Employment Changes, Employment Verification, etc. including follow up with mangers and HRBPs to clarify information, obtain approvals or request corrections. Process the transactions accomplishing KPIs defined per processes and according to the Case Management Framework and the SOX Matrix. Audits of data entry accuracy done by HR Ops team members Well versed with data protection principles, knows how to process confidential and sensitive employee information. Attention to detail – be able to accurately process transaction. Solid understanding of Workday and HR Service Now. Articulate work instructions and write standard operating procedure (SOPs). Support other team members and new joiners. Participate in regional and global projects to support regional HR initiatives. What we look for 2
- 5 years of work experience in HR Shared Services. Good at multi-tasking and time management to manage the workload efficiently. Good excel skills (vlookup, PIVOTs, formatting etc) Experience working in a global or multinational company with strong stakeholder management skills. Flexible in shifts to support AMER. Self-motivated and a quick learner, be able to deliver under challenging and dynamic environment to meet changing demands of customers. Good to have experience in Sumtotal, Cornerstone or any relevant learning management systems.

jobDescription: Job Description Job Description Who we are Johnson Controls is a world leader in smart buildings, creating safe, healthy and sustainable spaces. For nearly 140 years, we’ve made buildings better and now we’re transforming them again with our award-winning digital technologies and services. We’re using artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions to give you deeper insight into your building’s health, sustainability and performance. It’s changing the way we design, operates and maintains indoor environments and driving to a new era of autonomous buildings. We deliver the blueprint of the future for industries such as healthcare, schools, data centers, airports, stadiums, hotels, manufacturing and beyond through Open Blue, our comprehensive suite of connected solutions. Johnson Controls offers the world’s largest portfolio of building technology, software and services. Supported by a team of more than 100,000 dedicated employees working across 150 countries, we’re helping customers achieve their sustainability goals and power their mission. Please visit and follow Johnson Controls linkedin for recent exciting activities. APAC Linkedin Johnson Controls APAC Linkedin Career The Power Behind Your Mission Open Blue Open Blue: This is How a Space Comes Alive What you will do: Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced HVAC professional to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing top-quality service, maintenance, and repair of HVAC and industrial refrigeration systems at various client facilities. You will serve as the primary contact for all technical service issues, ensuring client satisfaction through effective troubleshooting and resolution of complex systems. Required Capabilities HVAC & Chiller Expertise Practical work experience with HVAC system with various York chiller models, primarily YK, YVAA, YMC2, and YZ chillers. Hands on Experience in commissioning of numerous chillers like Mag bearing, Centri, Screw, Scroll with different type of refrigerant R-22, R-134a, R407,R123, R1233ZD, R513A Hands on Experience in conducting the chiller PM activity for various model chillers. Good knowledge on AHUs, FCU, Cooling towers, water Pumps, EC fans used in the HVAC system. Capable to handle the critical issues by taking quick appropriate decision with action plans to resolve the issues. Electrical & Electronics Expertise Ability to test and diagnose power electronic components such as Diode, SCRs, IGBTs, capacitors, and inductors. Able to understand the Circuit Breaker settings and provide the cable sizing Understand the root cause of the power electronic components failure and be able to prepare the root cause analysis for the failure. Able to test and identify defective components at the PCB level in advanced multilayer electronic boards Able to troubleshoot the various types of motor used in the chiller application and AHUs Able to understand the various types of control logic used in chiller microcontrollers. Capable of programming and debugging software for microprocessor-based controllers and PLC-based controllers VSD starter & Troubleshooting In-depth understanding of Variable Speed Drive (VSD) starter application, benefits in chiller, terminology and working principles. Skilled in troubleshooting York starter models used in chillers, including D-Drive, Vyper, Hyper, and Python drives. Knowing the importance of the Harmonic Filter in the VSD application and its function and troubleshooting. Refrigeration System and Performance testing Knowledge Strong understanding of refrigeration systems and capability to troubleshoot issues using operating data, History data or SD card data from chillers. Able to interpret and analyze Pressure-Enthalpy (P–H) diagrams to evaluate refrigeration cycle performance, identify system inefficiencies, and assist in troubleshooting issues related to compressors, evaporators, and condensers Chiller performance testing and field troubleshooting of performance related issues. Understanding of psychrometry and its application in the HVAC industry Join Johnson Controls and be part of a team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and provides a rewarding work environment. Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

title: Sr. Application Engineer II-Presales Chiller - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away! What we offer: Competitive salary Paid vacation/holidays/sick time On the job/cross training opportunities Encouraging and collaborative team environment Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy What you will do: As a Technical Chillers expert, this role will be focused on Solution Development with complete accountability of Pre-Sales life cycle support. Drive the overall process of Application Engineering and ensure our customer receive the best solution as per requirements Enterprise Accounts Ownership: Work in close collaboration with our lead Account Managers & clients as the primary contact for technical support and Pre-Sales Engineering for Chillers. You will directly work with our enterprise clients, such as Vantage, Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Keppel, Air trunk, Micron, and others, right from the Pre-tendering phase all the way to Project handover. Value Engineering: Engage actively in offering the optimized solutions using available products to provide best techno commercial offering. Work closely with Chiller factories and Global Products Team on special quotes and complex technical compliance. Conduct thorough sweet spot analysis to ensure our specifications are included in the early stages of BOD projects. Basis of Design: Work closely with the BOD/Sales team to understand the Project needs and provide technical chiller solutions/specifications. By doing so, we aim to ensure that our offerings are well-integrated from the initial stages, leveraging our expertise to contribute to winning the project. Global Exposure:
- The candidate will work closely with the Regional Sales Team on Chillers Pre-Sales Engineering for local projects across the APAC region, covering countries like Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Hong Kong, India, Korea, Taiwan, Philippines and Australia. Mentorship: Guiding and coaching team members to enhance their skills through knowledge sharing. Field product management support:
- Collaborate with a cross-functional team, including Life Cycle Solutions, Sales, Global Products and Factory teams, to analyze trends, work on identifying product and solution gaps related to vertical market needs and provide insights and recommendations of new features to enhance products What we look for: BE/ME Mechanical or equivalent. Demonstrate a high level of knowledge of Chillers – Screw, Scroll & Centrifugal. A solid understanding of the principles of large refrigeration systems and associated equipment is required. Preference will be given to individuals having technical expertise in Chillers. Minimum 5 years of experience in Chillers product selection process, preparing selections, specifications review and quotations. Ability to perform successfully in a multifunctional-team-work environment and be able to work independently with minimal supervision. Must be a quick learner & should have a keen eye for problem solving Proficient in written and verbal communication Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills People management experience would be an added advantage. Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou .

title: Asst. Project Manager - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription: Job Description Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. Job Title: Assistant Project Manager – IBMS (Data Center Projects) Location: Gurgaon Payroll: Johnson Controls India (JCI) Job Summary We are looking for a candidate experience in IBMS with hands-on experience in executing Data Center projects . The candidate should have strong expertise in IBMS, CFS, CCTV, and Access Control Systems (ACS) , with exposure to installation, testing, commissioning, and project execution activities. Key Responsibilities Execute and coordinate IBMS and CFS projects for Data Center facilities. Manage installation, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of: Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS) CCTV Systems Access Control Systems (ACS) Fire Alarm & Life Safety Systems Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, and internal teams for smooth project execution. Monitor project schedules, quality standards, and safety compliance. Prepare technical documentation, testing reports, commissioning reports, and handover documents. Attend site meetings and provide regular project progress updates. Support site surveys, system integration, and customer acceptance testing activities. Required Qualification & Experience Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or related Engineering discipline. 5+ years of experience in IBMS/CFS project execution. Mandatory experience in Data Center projects . Hands-on experience in: IBMS CCTV Access Control Systems (ACS) Fire Alarm Systems Building Automation Systems (BMS) Experience in testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project execution. Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and manage site activities independently. Preferred Profile Experience working on large-scale Data Center projects. Knowledge of ELV systems integration and commissioning. Strong communication and coordination skills. Willingness to travel to project sites as per business requirements

title: PLM Solution Developer - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription: Job Description Job Title: PLM Solution Developer Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India What you will do: As a PLM Solution Developer, you will be responsible for guiding the direction and execution of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that PLM initiatives are aligned with business goals and deliver value throughout the product lifecycle, from ideation to production. How you will do it: design and implementation of PLM strategies and solutions that drive product development efficiency. Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and IT teams to integrate PLM processes across the organization. Identify and analyze business requirements to develop clear PLM system specifications. Facilitate training and support for end-users to ensure successful adoption of PLM tools and processes. Monitor and evaluate PLM system performance and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Manage relationships with PLM software vendors and oversee system upgrades and enhancements. Develop and maintain documentation for PLM processes, policies, and procedures. Stay current with industry trends and best practices in PLM and recommend solutions to enhance business operations. What we look for: Bachelor's or higher degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 10-12 years of experience in PLM, product development, or a related field. Proven track record of implementing and managing PLM solutions in a manufacturing environment. Strong knowledge of PLM tools (preferably Windchill, Teamcenter) and methodologies. Excellent leadership and project management skills. Effective communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Experience with ERP systems (like SAP) is a plus. What we offer: Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and retirement plans. Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning. A collaborative and inclusive work environment. JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories.

title: Project Manager - Applied - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription: Job Description Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. Job Description –Project Manager – Applied (Chillers) Grade: 169/170 Location: Mumbai Reporting To: Senior Project Manager – Applied Projects Experience: 5–8 Years Role Summary The incumbent will be responsible for managing the execution of multiple HVAC and chiller projects simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery in line with customer requirements, contractual commitments, and company objectives. The role will focus on project planning, coordination, schedule management, commercial follow-up, and driving projects through defined toll gates from HOTO to closure. The incumbent will work closely with customers, vendors, site teams, and internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Project Execution & Coordination Manage HVAC/chiller old, ongoing and new projects at different stages of execution. Ensure projects are executed as per approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements. Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, vendors, factories, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution. Track project milestones and drive closure of pending activities. Schedule Management Prepare and maintain project schedules in coordination with customers and internal stakeholders. Obtain customer approval for schedule baselines during HOTO. Monitor progress against planned schedules and initiate corrective actions for delays. Drive timely completion of project milestones and support toll gate movement. Commercial & Financial Management Monitor project costs, committed costs, and revenue realization. Support achievement of forecasted revenue for assigned projects. Ensure timely preparation and submission of invoices as per contractual milestones. Follow up with customers for payment collections and resolution of commercial issues. Maintain Unbilled Revenue (UBR) within prescribed limits. Risk & Issue Management Identify project risks and implementation challenges at an early stage. Maintain project risk and issue logs. Escalate critical risks, delays, and customer concerns to the Senior Project Manager in a timely manner. Work with stakeholders to implement mitigation and recovery plans. Customer Management Act as the primary point of contact for assigned projects. Maintain regular communication with customers regarding project status, schedules, deliveries, and outstanding actions. Address customer concerns promptly and coordinate internal support for resolution. Ensure customer expectations are effectively managed throughout the project lifecycle. Material & Resource Coordination Coordinate with procurement, logistics, factory, and service teams to ensure timely deliveries. Track material availability and installation readiness. Monitor resource deployment requirements at project sites. Reporting & Governance Update project status, forecasts, and financial metrics regularly. Participate in project review meetings and provide accurate project performance updates. Ensure compliance with organizational project management processes and documentation requirements. Support movement of projects through defined stage gates and successful project closure. Desired Skills & Competencies Good understanding of HVAC systems, chillers, and applied projects. Knowledge of project management fundamentals including: Planning and Scheduling Cost Monitoring Risk Management Quality Compliance Customer Management Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Good communication and negotiation skills. Proficiency in MS Project, Excel, ERP, and project tracking tools. Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline. PMP/Project Management certification would be an added advantage. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) On-time achievement of project milestones. Successful movement of projects through toll gates. Revenue realization against forecast. Timely invoicing and collection performance. UBR maintained within target limits. Customer satisfaction. Schedule adherence. Quality and safety compliance. Timely closure of project risks and issues.

About Johnson Controls Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. Achieve the allotted AOP and sales targets for the region, demonstrating a commitment to outcomes with accountability, safety, and integrity. Generate sales opportunities for the Johnson Controls HVAC product range tailored to the Data Center Vertical Customer Accounts, ensuring a customer-focused approach while removing obstacles to enhance their experience. Negotiate offers and contract terms, including legal, financial, payment, and other terms, while ensuring adherence to organizational approval matrices. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field. 10+ years of experience in HVAC product sales, with a focus on the datacenter industry. Proficiency in developing Go-To-Market strategies for HVAC products aimed at the Data Center sector. Strong networking skills and a well-established connection with leading HVAC consultants and contractors. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills. title: Deputy Manager - HVAC - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription:
Job Description Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. Job Role
- Deputy Manager
- HVAC Location
- Kolkata On role
- JCI Payroll Core Site Execution Responsibilities (York Chillers): Equipment Handling: Supervise the rigging, positioning, and installation of heavy-duty York chillers, cooling towers, and primary/secondary chilled water pumps, Chilled water pipeline, condenser pipeline including valves. Testing & Commissioning: Coordinate with manufacturer technicians (e.g., Johnson Controls) for pre-commissioning checks, refrigerant charging, and performance testing. System Integration: Oversee the installation of the Chiller Plant Manager (CPM) / Chiller Management System (CMS) . This includes calibrating sensors, Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), and modulating valves for optimal load management. Site Quality & Safety: Ensure compliance with strict EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) protocols, piping pressure testing, and ASHRAE/local electrical safety standards. CPM System (Critical Path Method & Chiller Plant Management) Responsibility of Project Manager in this field:
1. CPM as Critical Path Method (Project Scheduling) Timeline Management: Build and maintain detailed project schedules identifying the longest sequence of dependent activities required to complete the project on time. Resource Crashing & Leveling: Identify critical tasks—such as chiller delivery lead times, piping fabrication, and electrical integration—to prevent bottlenecks and trade stacking Milestone Tracking: Monitor the schedule for zero-float tasks to ensure testing, commissioning, and final handover are achieved by the contractual deadline.
2. CPM as Chiller Plant Manager (Operational Control) Plant Optimization: Utilize the CPM system, an automated DDC (Direct Digital Control) panel, to sequence chillers based on cooling load demands. Energy Efficiency: Implement CPM sequences to balance equipment run hours, control VFDs, and optimize condenser water temperatures for maximum energy savings General Project Management Duties Budget & Contracts: Manage project financials, process variation orders, and approve contractor progress billing. Stakeholder Coordination: Act as the primary liaison between the client, architects, MEP consultants, and equipment vendors. Risk Mitigation: Identify technical, logistical, or contractual risks early and implement solutions to avoid project delays.

jobDescription: Job Description Who we are? About Johnson Controls Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. Visit johnsoncontrols.com for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms. Why JCI: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg Asia-Pacific Linked In: https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feed View=all Career: The Power Behind Your Mission Open Blue: This is How a Space Comes Alive Job Summary: Manager – Sustainable Infrastructure Sales is responsible for driving sales growth, customer engagement, and execution coordination for Energy Performance Contracting (EPC) and retrofit solutions within the assigned region . The role reports to the Regional Manager / Vertical Leader – Sustainable Infrastructure and is critical in translating regional strategy into ground results. What will you do? Own the assigned sales targets for EPC , retrofit, and sustainability-driven solutions. Develop and execute account plans for key customers, consultants, and partners. Develop vendors and work with subcontractors for competitive bid submissions Identify, qualify, and convert opportunities in chiller upgrades, HVAC retrofits, controls, and digital solutions. Support in building proposals for performance-based contracts including CAPEX, OPEX, and Energy-as-a-Service models. Coordinate with engineering, service, finance, and legal teams to ensure solution feasibility and timely deal closures. Support smooth project handover and execution governance, ensuring customer satisfaction. Ensure compliance with IPMVP measurement and verification protocols. Align projects with sustainability standards such as ECBC, LEED, and GRIHA. Maintain accurate pipeline forecasting and CRM reporting. What we look for? Min 8-10 Years of domain experience BE/B.Tech (Mechanical, Industrial Engg, Electrical & Electronics, Production Engg) Any other graduate but with deep domain knowledge matching JD can be an exception Structured articulation, keeps up to date with what's happening inside and outside, analytical mindset and sales acumen Candidate is a self-driven person, self-reflection and problem-solving skill when comes to challenges Shall be a team collaborative person What we offer: We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

title: Technical Support Manager - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription: Job Description Job Description Who we are Johnson Controls is a world leader in smart buildings, creating safe, healthy and sustainable spaces. For nearly 140 years, we’ve made buildings better and now we’re transforming them again with our award-winning digital technologies and services. We’re using artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions to give you deeper insight into your building’s health, sustainability and performance. It’s changing the way we design, operates and maintains indoor environments and driving to a new era of autonomous buildings. We deliver the blueprint of the future for industries such as healthcare, schools, data centers, airports, stadiums, hotels, manufacturing and beyond through Open Blue, our comprehensive suite of connected solutions. Johnson Controls offers the world’s largest portfolio of building technology, software and services. Supported by a team of more than 100,000 dedicated employees working across 150 countries, we’re helping customers achieve their sustainability goals and power their mission. Please visit and follow Johnson Controls linkedin for recent exciting activities. APAC Linkedin Johnson Controls APAC Linkedin Career The Power Behind Your Mission Open Blue Open Blue: This is How a Space Comes Alive What you will do: Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced HVAC professional to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing top-quality service, maintenance, and repair of HVAC and industrial refrigeration systems at various client facilities. You will serve as the primary contact for all technical service issues, ensuring client satisfaction through effective troubleshooting and resolution of complex systems. Required Capabilities HVAC & Chiller Expertise Practical work experience with HVAC system with various York chiller models, primarily YK, YVAA, YMC2, and YZ chillers. Hands on Experience in commissioning of numerous chillers like Mag bearing, Centri, Screw, Scroll with different type of refrigerant R-22, R-134a, R407,R123, R1233ZD, R513A Hands on Experience in conducting the chiller PM activity for various model chillers. Good knowledge on AHUs, FCU, Cooling towers, water Pumps, EC fans used in the HVAC system. Capable to handle the critical issues by taking quick appropriate decision with action plans to resolve the issues. Electrical & Electronics Expertise Ability to test and diagnose power electronic components such as Diode, SCRs, IGBTs, capacitors, and inductors. Able to understand the Circuit Breaker settings and provide the cable sizing Understand the root cause of the power electronic components failure and be able to prepare the root cause analysis for the failure. Able to test and identify defective components at the PCB level in advanced multilayer electronic boards Able to troubleshoot the various types of motor used in the chiller application and AHUs Able to understand the various types of control logic used in chiller microcontrollers. Capable of programming and debugging software for microprocessor-based controllers and PLC-based controllers VSD starter & Troubleshooting In-depth understanding of Variable Speed Drive (VSD) starter application, benefits in chiller, terminology and working principles. Skilled in troubleshooting York starter models used in chillers, including D-Drive, Vyper, Hyper, and Python drives. Knowing the importance of the Harmonic Filter in the VSD application and its function and troubleshooting. Refrigeration System and Performance testing Knowledge Strong understanding of refrigeration systems and capability to troubleshoot issues using operating data, History data or SD card data from chillers. Able to interpret and analyze Pressure-Enthalpy (P–H) diagrams to evaluate refrigeration cycle performance, identify system inefficiencies, and assist in troubleshooting issues related to compressors, evaporators, and condensers Chiller performance testing and field troubleshooting of performance related issues. Understanding of psychrometry and its application in the HVAC industry Join Johnson Controls and be part of a team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and provides a rewarding work environment. Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

title: POD Leader - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription: Job Description POD Leader – APAC Security Pre-sales What you will do The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Security System global projects as per country specific standards. You will be executing & supervising presales engineering and estimation activities in line with the codes and standards by keeping operational parameters within budget. Always maintain project quality and on-time delivery as per the front desk/sales expectation. Handle a team of 8 to 10 presales engineers with the technical ownership of the presales’ projects. Extensive knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction. How you will do it You will have to work closely with your peers and team members in security domain presales engineering. You will be responsible for the following critical activities to deliver best-in-class solutions with your technical expertise. Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project. Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Security System (Access, Video, Intrusion, ICT, Complete ELV system etc) Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting. Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget. Ability to create and review of bill of material, selection of Backend, Controllers, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Security System. Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc. Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction. Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences. Identify and mitigate project risks and issues in the early stage of the project. Ensure errors are monitored and take corrective action/preventive action to meet quality standards. Properly plan resources for each project. Monitor and control the agreed work scope against the project plan. Manage changes to the baselines through an adequate change management process. Support the team members as & when needed on technical aspects as well as on vendors and Subcon support follow-ups. Help the team to produce multiple solutions with technical and commercial differentiations. Explore ways and means to secure the projects and improve win-rate through market intelligence. Keep a record of the team's performance and ensure all KPIs (Utilization, OTD, Quality, Kaizen Counts, etc.) are met. Regularly work on the team's competency development to meet the customer's technological requirements. Ensure Time Tracker discipline and ISO processes adherence. Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress. Approve Concur Expense submissions of the team members. Monitor and update the SFDC cases on time and keep handy customized reports to avoid any miss outs. Keep operational parameters at the desired level for all assigned projects. Drive innovation and continuous improvement to form a high-performance culture in the team. Ensure active participation in the organization's employee engagement initiatives.

title: HR Technology Analyst – HCM Core Workday - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription: Job Description What You Will Do As an HR Technology Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting Workday organizational structure maintenance, HR data governance, and system operations across the organization. You will serve as a strategic partner to HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business leaders by translating business requirements into effective Workday solutions that support operational efficiency and workforce management. Demonstrating Workday expertise, the HR Technology team partners with HR stakeholders to answer system functionality questions, resolve issues, maintain organizational structures, and ensure data integrity. The Analyst will play a critical role in maintaining Workday organizational data, including supervisory organizations, cost centers, locations, and related business structures while supporting key HR processes and organizational changes. How You Will Do It Configure and maintain Workday organizational structures, including Supervisory Organizations, Cost Centers, Companies, Locations, Business Sites, and Custom Organizations. Manage organizational changes resulting from restructures, acquisitions, divestitures, leadership transitions, and workforce planning initiatives. Partner with HR, Finance, Payroll, and business leaders to ensure organizational data is accurate, compliant, and aligned with business requirements. Maintain organizational hierarchies and support governance processes related to workforce structure and management. Analyze and validate organizational data to ensure consistency and integrity across Workday. Support HR business processes that rely on accurate organizational assignments and structure maintenance. Serve as a subject matter expert for Workday organizational management functionality and related business processes. Troubleshoot and resolve system issues related to organizational structures, staffing models, and worker assignments. Lead testing efforts for Workday releases and enhancements, validating organizational structures, security access, and business process functionality. Support security administration to ensure appropriate access to organizational and workforce data. Collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement. Create and maintain process documentation, governance procedures, and end-user training materials. Participate in Workday enhancement projects, including organizational redesign initiatives and process improvements. Support audits, compliance activities, and data governance initiatives through accurate maintenance of organizational structures. What We Look For Required Degree in Business, Human Resources, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience. Experience working with Human Capital Management systems, preferably Workday. Strong experience supporting and maintaining organizational structures within Workday. Knowledge of workforce structures, organizational design, and HR operational processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into system solutions. Experience partnering with HR, Finance, and business stakeholders. Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong customer service focus and commitment to continuous improvement. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Highly Desirable Workday Experience Workday Organization Management Supervisory Organizations Cost Centers Companies Locations Business Sites Custom Organizations Organizational Hierarchies Reorganizations and Realignments Staffing Model Maintenance Position Management

title: Development Engineer – Embedded Software / Firmware (PAGA/PAVA Systems) - Johnson Controls Careers
jobDescription: Job Description Who we are? About Johnson Controls Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. Visit johnsoncontrols.com for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms. Why JCI: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg Asia-Pacific Linked In: https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feed View=all Career: The Power Behind Your Mission Open Blue: This is How a Space Comes Alive What will you do? Design and implement C/C++ software for (bare-metal and RTOS) embedded devices to be used in safety related Public Address / General Alarm systems. Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded C / C++ firmware for STM32-based control and communication modules. Implement low-level software for microcontroller peripherals, memory handling, interrupt management, watchdogs, boot behaviour, and hardware abstraction. Support board bring-up, integration, debugging, and validation of new embedded platforms. Development of engineering interpretations of product standards. Create test plans and perform verification and validation activities. Author documentation for software architecture, interface control, test plans. Develop algorithms for digital audio streaming, routing and processing. Implement communication protocols using Ethernet, Lon Talk, RS232, RS485 and RS422. Contribute to software quality MISRA C/C++, static analysis, configuration management, code reviews, development of unit and integration tests. Collaborate with the estimation, production, commissioning and projects departments to derive requirements, and time scales for delivery of system solutions. Mentor less experienced engineers. Maintain older product: Defect rectification, bespoke solutions to meet customer requirements, solutions to hardware obsolescence. What we look for? Support the migration of legacy Echelon / CPM5000 communication and control functions to a new embedded architecture. Analyse existing legacy behaviour and develop equivalent or improved implementations on STM32-based platforms. Help define the migration path for Lon Talk-related stack behaviour, node communications, and interoperability requirements. Contribute to long-term removal of obsolete components and reduction of platform dependency risk. Integrate firmware with higher-level software modules, communication stacks, diagnostics, and application functions used in PAGA / PAVA systems. Support interaction between physical layer interfaces, node communications, and application-layer functions used for alarm, paging, routing, monitoring, and supervision. Ensure effective transfer of amplifier and field-device fault information back to system nodes and controllers. Audio & Life-Safety Functional Support Support embedded functions related to 100V line audio systems, amplifier supervision, fault monitoring, and status reporting. Develop software mechanisms for continuous system health checking, fault detection, and reporting. Support deterministic and reliable behaviour required for critical alarm and public address functions. Verification, Debug & Product Support Investigate and resolve issues arising from development, manufacturing, commissioning, and field service. Use structured testing, logging, and diagnostic methods to validate firmware performance and robustness. Support regression testing and change control for product releases. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with hardware engineers, project engineers, manufacturing, test, and service teams. Support design reviews, system architecture activities, and issue resolution across the product lifecycle. Contribute to documentation required for product introduction, controlled change, validation, and support. What we offer: We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

About Johnson Controls Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. Visit johnsoncontrols.com for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms. Why JCI: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg Asia-Pacific Linked In: https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feed View=all Career: The Power Behind Your Mission Open Blue: This is How a Space Comes Alive What will you do? Design and implement C/C++ software for (bare-metal and RTOS) embedded devices to be used in safety related Public Address / General Alarm systems. Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded C / C++ firmware for STM32-based control and communication modules. Implement low-level software for microcontroller peripherals, memory handling, interrupt management, watchdogs, boot behaviour, and hardware abstraction. Support board bring-up, integration, debugging, and validation of new embedded platforms. Development of engineering interpretations of product standards. Create test plans and perform verification and validation activities. Author documentation for software architecture, interface control, test plans. Develop algorithms for digital audio streaming, routing and processing. Implement communication protocols using Ethernet, Lon Talk, RS232, RS485 and RS422. Contribute to software quality MISRA C/C++, static analysis, configuration management, code reviews, development of unit and integration tests. Collaborate with the estimation, production, commissioning and projects departments to derive requirements, and time scales for delivery of system solutions. Mentor less experienced engineers. Maintain older product: Defect rectification, bespoke solutions to meet customer requirements, solutions to hardware obsolescence. What we look for? Support the migration of legacy Echelon / CPM5000 communication and control functions to a new embedded architecture. Analyse existing legacy behaviour and develop equivalent or improved implementations on STM32-based platforms. Help define the migration path for Lon Talk-related stack behaviour, node communications, and interoperability requirements. Contribute to long-term removal of obsolete components and reduction of platform dependency risk. Integrate firmware with higher-level software modules, communication stacks, diagnostics, and application functions used in PAGA / PAVA systems. Support interaction between physical layer interfaces, node communications, and application-layer functions used for alarm, paging, routing, monitoring, and supervision. Ensure effective transfer of amplifier and field-device fault information back to system nodes and controllers. Audio & Life-Safety Functional Support Support embedded functions related to 100V line audio systems, amplifier supervision, fault monitoring, and status reporting. Develop software mechanisms for continuous system health checking, fault detection, and reporting. Support deterministic and reliable behaviour required for critical alarm and public address functions. Verification, Debug & Product Support Investigate and resolve issues arising from development, manufacturing, commissioning, and field service. Use structured testing, logging, and diagnostic methods to validate firmware performance and robustness. Support regression testing and change control for product releases. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with hardware engineers, project engineers, manufacturing, test, and service teams. Support design reviews, system architecture activities, and issue resolution across the product lifecycle. Contribute to documentation required for product introduction, controlled change, validation, and support. What we offer: We offer an exciting and challenging position. jobDescription: Job Description What you will do Technical lead – Applied Chiller The technical lead will be part of the team responsible for managing and leading a team of mechanical and electrical design engineers focused for product development and sustenance of JCI Global products. He/she will have the skills that will meet the job demands for this year’s projects. The technical lead must possess the ability to self‐start with limited guidance. The technical lead will work alongside other engineering teams, such as Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, and IT related personnel. This individual to hold meetings regularly to update activities and milestones. Manage engineering documentation, including BOMs, CAD models, and technical specifications. Evaluate and implement methodologies to enhance errorfree deliverables and CAD automation to improve individual productivity. Mentor and develop engineering talent, fostering a high performance team culture. The primary focus for this technical lead will be to lead the innovation to the chiller, design reviews, implement new processes ensuring quality and timeliness design release of the product development and manufacturing drawings for self and other team members. How you will do it Design & Development of commercial and industrial chillers & their components. • A creative flair and design ability as per application. • Build and motivate team to follow standard procedures and practices for engineering works. • Ensure timely delivery of engineering documentation to meet internal and external project schedules. • Guarantee product compliance with relevant industry standards and safety regulations. • Collaborate with procurement and manufacturing teams to optimize designs for cost effectiveness and manufacturability. • Manage project schedules, identify risks, and ensure successful delivery of engineering milestones. • Promote innovation and continuous improvement in product design and development processes. • Provide technical mentorship and support to junior engineers within the team. What we look for • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical or electrical Engineering. • 10+ years of experience in industrial refrigeration product design, with at least 3 years in a leadership role. • Strong knowledge of thermodynamics, heat transfer, and refrigeration cycles. • Familiarity with global compliance and certification standards (UL, CE, ASME, etc.). • Proficiency in CAD tools (e.g., Auto CAD, Creo) & Windchill • Experience with product development processes, DFMEA, DVP&R, and stage-gate methodologies. • Excellent communication, project management, and team leadership skills. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors

jobDescription:
Job Description Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away! What we offer: Competitive salary Paid vacation/holidays/sick time On the job/cross training opportunities Encouraging and collaborative team environment Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy What you will do Provide technical product application support ( mech plus electrical knowledge) to sales teams in pursuit of air cooled chiller equipment sales opportunities in the India Market, to power our customer’s mission by utilizing the right equipment for the application. Successful application engineering support will accomplish team mission through three key avenues. How you will do it Application and Special Quotation Support Respond to field sales inquiries related to Chiller / Heat pump application/technical/manufacturing capabilities in connection with product specifications Identify and guide field sales toward solutions necessary to meet customer requirements Support projects with requirements of several products and optimize the final scope of supply Review and evaluate special options requirements and support SQ (Special Quote) needs by providing cost and lead time estimates Requires development of subcomponent specifications, supplier engagement and negotiation, and analysis of factory manufacturing capability Expert Solutions Support field sales on technical clarifications with customers, potentially requiring direct engagement with customers Guide field sales and key customers on system design approaches and enhance competitive advantage by specifying tailored equipment packages. Expert solutions will balance chiller performances with sub-system components and features Align field support with knowledge of chiller products available in the market, and with regional product strategy Define specifications for chillers and sub-systems in support of project opportunities Product & Product Applications Development Monitor and analyze frequent questions, requests and pitfalls to identify new applications, develop new special quotation offerings, and guide global product teams. Provide necessary material for literature applications, product presentations, and training materials Collect and offer constructive feedback to global product teams on resources, tools and documentation available to field sales and customers Deliver training presentations on product changes and new products to field sales and key customers Engagement in industry organizations and technical seminars Monitor and offer formal comment on product/application relevant codes and standards What we look for BE/ Btech
- Mechanical or Electrical and minimum 3 years of HVAC or refrigeration related experience in application engineering, product engineering or technical marketing is required. Demonstrated business management skills in product application environment preferred Technically savvy, possessing strong knowledge of application and field practices related to air cooled chillers Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite Applications Strong verbal and written English skills
